name: battery-swap-mcps
description: Install every BatterySwap MCP definition together.

interface.shortDescription: All BatterySwap MCPs in one install
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to all requested BatterySwap and supporting remote MCP definitions through one installable plugin. Optional servers cannot block healthy siblings, and credentials remain stored on each device.
defaultPrompt: Use the connected BatterySwap MCP tools. Prefer read-only calls unless I explicitly request a change.
